page.overview:
Who is Basque?

Basque pilots the purple Turtle mecha in the short, Teenage Mecha Ninja Turtles.

Basque is the strong and smart member of the team, as well as lovable, somewhat timid, friendly, cautious, clever, and able to remain level-headed while in tough situations. He also serves as his group's voice of reason, usually the one who diffuses the tension among his friends.
